questions.subject: HTML
questions.topic: HTML introduction, syntax, and document structure
questions.question: What does HTML stand for?
questions.explanation: HTML stands for Hyper Text Markup Language, the standard markup language for documents designed to be displayed in a web browser.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.topic: HTML introduction, syntax, and document structure
questions.question: Which declaration is mandatory at the top of an HTML5 document?
questions.explanation: <!DOCTYPE html> instructs the browser to parse the document using the standard HTML5 rendering engine.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.topic: HTML introduction, syntax, and document structure
questions.question: Which HTML tag is the root element of an HTML page?
questions.explanation: The <html> element encapsulates all content and sub-elements on an HTML document.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which HTML tag defines the most important or top-level heading?
questions.explanation: <h1> defines the highest level heading in HTML document hierarchy.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which HTML element is used to define a paragraph?
questions.explanation:
The

element represents a paragraph of text.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which element is used to insert a line break without starting a new paragraph?
questions.explanation:
The
element produces a line break in text (an inline newline).

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which attribute specifies the URL of the page the link goes to in an <a> tag?
questions.explanation: The 'href' attribute specifies the hyperlink target URL.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which attribute of the tag specifies an alternate text if the image cannot be displayed?
questions.explanation: The 'alt' attribute provides alternative text for accessibility and broken image fallback.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which HTML tag is used to create an ordered (numbered) list?
questions.explanation: The <ol> element creates an ordered list of items.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which HTML tag is used to create an unordered (bulleted) list?
questions.explanation: The <ul> element creates an unordered list.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which tag defines an individual list item inside <ul> or <ol>?
questions.explanation: The <li> tag represents an individual item inside a list.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which tag is used to define a table row in HTML?
questions.explanation: The <tr> tag defines a table row containing cells.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which tag defines a standard data cell inside an HTML table row?
questions.explanation: The <td> tag defines a standard data cell in a table.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which tag defines a header cell in an HTML table, rendering text bold and centered by default?
questions.explanation: The <th> tag defines a header cell in a table.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.topic: Forms, input types, labels, and validation
questions.question: Which element is used to create an interactive form for user input?
questions.explanation: The <form> element wraps form controls and handles submission behavior.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.topic: Forms, input types, labels, and validation
questions.question: What is the default 'type' attribute value for an <input> tag if omitted?
questions.explanation: If type is not specified, an <input> element defaults to type="text".

questions.subject: HTML
questions.topic: Forms, input types, labels, and validation
questions.question: Which input type allows users to select only ONE option from a group?
questions.explanation: Radio buttons sharing the same 'name' attribute form a group where only one option can be selected.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.topic: Forms, input types, labels, and validation
questions.question: Which input type creates a clickable button that submits form data to the server?
questions.explanation: An input with type="submit" submits the enclosing form.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.topic: Forms, input types, labels, and validation
questions.question: Which attribute on an <input> field makes it obligatory for the user to fill it before submitting?
questions.explanation: The 'required' boolean attribute prevents form submission if the input field is empty.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which tag is a generic container used to group inline elements and text for styling?
questions.explanation: The <span> tag is a generic inline container that takes up only as much width as necessary.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which tag is a generic block-level container used to structure content sections?
questions.explanation: The <div> tag is a generic block-level container that starts on a new line and spans full width.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Where are metadata and script/style declarations usually placed in an HTML file?
questions.explanation: The <head> section contains document metadata, titles, styles, and external script links.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which attribute opens a linked document in a new browser tab or window in an <a> tag?
questions.explanation: target="_blank" forces the browser to open the hyperlink in a new browsing context/tab.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which tag is used to draw a horizontal rule (thematic break) in HTML?
questions.explanation: The <hr> tag represents a thematic break between paragraph-level elements.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: How do you write a comment in HTML?
questions.explanation: HTML comments start with <!-- and end with -->.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which global attribute provides extra advisory information displayed as a tooltip on hover?
questions.explanation: The global 'title' attribute shows text as a tooltip when hovering over the element.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which element gives text strong importance, displaying it in bold by default?
questions.explanation: The <strong> tag indicates high importance, seriousness, or urgency, rendered bold.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which element marks text with stress emphasis, displaying it in italics by default?
questions.explanation: The <em> element represents stress emphasis, typically displayed in italics.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which HTML tag is used to link an external CSS stylesheet?
questions.explanation: The <link> element with rel="stylesheet" imports external CSS style files.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which tag is used to embed client-side JavaScript code in an HTML document?
questions.explanation: The <script> tag embeds or references executable JavaScript code.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.topic: Forms, input types, labels, and validation
questions.question: Which tag provides a text label for a form control, improving usability and accessibility?
questions.explanation: The <label> tag associates textual descriptions with form controls using the 'for' attribute.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.topic: Forms, input types, labels, and validation
questions.question: Which attribute in a <label> connects it to the 'id' of its corresponding <input>?
questions.explanation: The 'for' attribute on a <label> matches the 'id' attribute of the target input element.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.topic: Forms, input types, labels, and validation
questions.question: Which tag creates a multi-line text input field in a form?
questions.explanation: The <textarea> tag provides a multi-line plain-text editing control.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.topic: Forms, input types, labels, and validation
questions.question: Which tag creates a drop-down menu in HTML forms?
questions.explanation: The <select> element creates a drop-down list of choices.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.topic: Forms, input types, labels, and validation
questions.question: Which tag defines individual choices inside a <select> drop-down list?
questions.explanation: <option> elements represent individual options in a <select> menu.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which tag defines the title of the document shown in the browser's tab?
questions.explanation: The <title> tag sets the title of the document in browser tabs and search engine results.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which tag is used to group body content in an HTML table?
questions.explanation: The <tbody> tag encapsulates the primary data rows of an HTML table.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which attribute merges multiple adjacent columns in an HTML table cell?
questions.explanation: The 'colspan' attribute specifies the number of columns a cell should span across.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which attribute merges multiple adjacent rows in an HTML table cell?
questions.explanation: The 'rowspan' attribute specifies the number of rows a cell should span across.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which HTML entity code represents the copyright symbol (©)?
questions.explanation: The entity © displays the copyright symbol © in HTML.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which HTML entity code represents a non-breaking space?
questions.explanation: The   entity represents a non-breaking space character.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: What is the key difference between the 'id' and 'class' attributes?

options.A: 'id' must be unique per page, whereas 'class' can be reused across multiple elements
options.B: 'class' must be unique, 'id' can be repeated
options.C: 'id' is only for CSS, 'class' is for JS

questions.explanation: An 'id' must be unique within a document, while a 'class' can be applied to multiple elements.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which HTML5 tag is used to embed video content natively without third-party plugins?
questions.explanation: The <video> tag natively embeds video files in HTML pages.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which HTML5 tag is used to embed audio content natively?
questions.explanation: The <audio> tag natively embeds audio streams or files.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which global attribute makes an HTML element editable directly by the user on the page?
questions.explanation: The 'contenteditable' attribute enables direct user editing of element text.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which <meta> tag setting ensures correct mobile responsive viewport rendering?
questions.explanation: The viewport meta tag configures dimensions and scaling on mobile devices.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which tag embeds another HTML document inside the current HTML page?
questions.explanation: An <iframe> (inline frame) embeds an external HTML document into the current page.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which semantic tag defines introductory content, headers, or navigation for a page/section?
questions.explanation: The <header> tag contains introductory or navigational elements.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which semantic tag defines footer content like copyright, terms, or contact information?
questions.explanation: The <footer> tag contains footer information for a document or section.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which semantic tag represents a section of page content designed for major navigation links?
questions.explanation: The <nav> tag encloses major navigation link groups.
